visual.name: bfusionSelectionWaterfall
visual.description: Project selection waterfall: projects stack in priority order against a budget line, showing what is funded, what is deferred and what to decide next.

dataRoles.name: projectName
dataRoles.description: Name of each project or initiative

dataRoles.description: Total available budget (single value drawn as the cut line)

dataRoles.name: strategicValue
dataRoles.description: Optional strategic alignment or benefit score shown in tooltips

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model
